pages.title: Picked and Growing Again
pages.text: Harvest supported crops without manually replanting them.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the hoe required by server settings, if any. Radius, hunger, experience and Fortune behavior depend on this server; no fixed area size is promised.

pages.title: Harvest and replant a ripe crop
pages.text: Right-click harvests a ripe supported crop and replants it when the interaction and configuration allow.

pages.title: Use an appropriate hoe for a larger harvest
pages.text: The allowed hoe, tier, Fortune, radius, hunger and experience follow server settings. Not every held item guarantees a larger area.
